title: Redwall
author: Brian Jacques
summary: The mice of Redwall Abbey live peacefully until an army of rats led by a one-eyed warlord lays siege to it. A young mouse novice must find the lost sword of the abbey's legendary founder, and he is not sure he is brave enough.
readIf: you want a classic children's adventure with talking animals, big feasts and a clear battle between good and evil.
skipIf: you want nuance in your villains, as they are usually simply wicked, and the battles can be fairly bloody.

pairings.reason: Another story of animals facing real danger, but far more serious and grounded in nature.
A gentler, quieter tale of animal friends with the same love of food and home.
Another cosy-but-adventurous story of a small hero who becomes braver than expected.
